description: Frozen, provider-neutral graph for roadmap workflow W2. Targets are declared as abstract capability roles, not bound to any concrete provider (e.g. neither prototype/bootstrap's target/local nor target/ssh is named here). A future E04/E08 experiment or T3/T6 implementation supplies the actual provider(s) that satisfy each role.
profile_identity_note: No real provider exists yet to attest a profile before Gate 1 (see docs/decisions/0003-g0-t0-exit.md and E04's open questions). 'example_profile' below on each target is illustrative, hand-authored example data showing the SHAPE a resolved profile identity must have and what a golden check can compare against once a real provider exists - it is not measured from any execution and does not claim any implementation currently produces it.

targets.notes: Any provider offering a Linux execution profile capable of compiling the backend binary. Must expose an execution profile identity before this node is placed (AC #2).

Any Linux-capable provider satisfying the same capability requirement as linux-build. This fixture explicitly does not assume linux-test is the same worker instance as linux-build - a compatible but distinct worker must be an equally valid placement, which is exactly what the downstream-failure-resume and worker-loss scenarios exercise.
The invoking controller/local machine. Read-only inspection of the transferred artifact only - no build or test execution here, so it never needs a Linux execution profile.
